files.adopted_method: Arrival intent and its factual basis, page-specific question/evidence/friction/next-action alignment; simulation remains a hypothesis.

targets.section: 咨询与转化路径：按需走查
targets.change: Short optional method following audience perspective; preserve existing audit and WCAG criteria.
Conditional consultation/conversion audit route and source attribution.
Agency Agents attribution and MIT notice link.

excluded_rules: Fixed iPhone or viewport and scroll distances
Mandatory five-second test or two voices per fold
Fixed result count or complete invented persona
Simulation presented as real user research/testing
Independent PASS/HOLD gate or new authorization
preserved: Real browser normal-motion process verification and static/reduced-motion distinction
Existing WCAG criteria and implementation checks
All preset engineering code/data/scripts and historical source/license records
boundary: Selective text-method adaptation only; no upstream runtime/installer, independent entry or automation change; business effectiveness and host automatic loading require separate evidence.
